const SCENE_NAMES={living:'거실',entry:'현관',park:'야외공원'};
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const canvas=$('#viewer'), gl=canvas.getContext('webgl',{alpha:false,antialias:false,preserveDrawingBuffer:false});
const errorBox=$('#error');
if(!gl){errorBox.classList.add('show');throw new Error('WebGL unavailable');}

const vertexSource=`attribute vec2 aPosition;varying vec2 vUv;void main(){vUv=aPosition*.5+.5;gl_Position=vec4(aPosition,0.,1.);}`;
const fragmentSource=`precision highp float;
varying vec2 vUv;uniform vec2 uResolution;uniform float uYaw;uniform float uPitch;uniform float uFov;uniform int uMode;
uniform sampler2D uPano;uniform sampler2D uPX;uniform sampler2D uNX;uniform sampler2D uPY;uniform sampler2D uNY;uniform sampler2D uPZ;uniform sampler2D uNZ;
const float PI=3.141592653589793;
vec4 cubeSample(vec3 d){vec3 a=abs(d);vec2 q;if(a.x>=a.y&&a.x>=a.z){if(d.x>0.){q=vec2(-d.z,-d.y)/a.x;return texture2D(uPX,q*.5+.5);}q=vec2(d.z,-d.y)/a.x;return texture2D(uNX,q*.5+.5);}if(a.y>a.x&&a.y>=a.z){if(d.y>0.){q=vec2(d.x,d.z)/a.y;return texture2D(uPY,q*.5+.5);}q=vec2(d.x,-d.z)/a.y;return texture2D(uNY,q*.5+.5);}if(d.z>0.){q=vec2(d.x,-d.y)/a.z;return texture2D(uPZ,q*.5+.5);}q=vec2(-d.x,-d.y)/a.z;return texture2D(uNZ,q*.5+.5);}
void main(){vec2 p=vUv*2.-1.;float aspect=uResolution.x/uResolution.y;float t=tan(uFov*.5);float cy=cos(uYaw),sy=sin(uYaw),cp=cos(uPitch),sp=sin(uPitch);vec3 forward=vec3(sy*cp,sp,cy*cp);vec3 right=vec3(cy,0.,-sy);vec3 up=vec3(-sy*sp,cp,-cy*sp);vec3 d=normalize(forward+right*(p.x*t*aspect)+up*(p.y*t));vec4 c;if(uMode==0){float u=atan(d.x,d.z)/(2.*PI)+.5;float v=.5-asin(clamp(d.y,-1.,1.))/PI;c=texture2D(uPano,vec2(u,v));}else{c=cubeSample(d);}gl_FragColor=vec4(c.rgb,1.);}`;
function compile(type,source){const s=gl.createShader(type);gl.shaderSource(s,source);gl.compileShader(s);if(!gl.getShaderParameter(s,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))throw new Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(s));return s;}
const program=gl.createProgram();gl.attachShader(program,compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,vertexSource));gl.attachShader(program,compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,fragmentSource));gl.linkProgram(program);if(!gl.getProgramParameter(program,gl.LINK_STATUS))throw new Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(program));gl.useProgram(program);
const buf=gl.createBuffer();g
